findings.summary: reclaimLock re-reads the lock then renames it non-atomically (check at 158-160, rename at 164, verify at 171-176); a waiter can move a fresh live lock away so a second process creates the lock and enters the critical section concurrently, losing an update. Reproduced 3/3 in r3 (12/13 across r1-r3) as 23/24 entries with a planted stale lock and 24 processes. Out of this task's write scope and unfixed since r1; needs a separate fix task (or explicit authorization to change lib/), then re-verify this task.
